utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Kira, I’m spreading the word that the repair drive’s key window is Saturday from 10 to noon, with Faye helping then—can you make it or pass the invite along?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I can maybe make it, Quinn, but before I pass anything along can you confirm that Saturday 10 to noon is the official window and who’s organizing it?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes—Mara and I are planning around Saturday 10 to noon because that’s when Faye can help with check-in or sorting repairs, so that’s the key window to share.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Vik, I’m checking for Mina while I’m out—do you know who’s definitely bringing drills, ladders, or extension cords for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I don’t know for sure yet, Ira—Oren’s checking the list, so I’m only telling folks to come around 10 until he confirms what tools are covered.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, Vik—I’ll tell Mina that Oren’s checking the tool list, and I’ll keep passing along that Saturday 10 to noon is the key window with Faye helping then.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m making the repair drive list now, Rey, and I won’t pass along guesses—tonight I’m confirming who has drills, ladders, cords, what repairs are coming, and when Sam’s group arrives.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Eli. Rosa told me Sunday at the community center is focused first on broken locks, active leaks, and no heat, so I’ll quietly ask my building today and bring you only definite names or tools I can confirm.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, Rey—definite names only is just right. If you can get them to me by early evening, I’ll fold them into the list before I check back with Mina and Gus.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Faye, before we add anything to the repair drive list, can you tell me which repairs or volunteers are confirmed and which still need checking?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I only know Mara’s aiming for Saturday 10 to noon, and I’m good to help with check-in or sorting then. I’d still check with Mara before marking any other repairs or volunteers as confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Faye — I’ll mark you as available for check-in or sorting Saturday 10 to noon, and I’ll leave Mara’s timing and any other details as tentative until we confirm with her.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Bo, I’m still going off second-hand updates on the repair drive—have you heard anything confirmed about when Sam’s group is joining Mara’s crew this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Not confirmed yet, Nell—I’ve heard Mara and Opal both mentioned, so I’m checking with Mara directly before I repeat any time or crew details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo—that’s exactly the kind of caution I’m trying to keep too. If Mara confirms anything, could you let me know so I don’t pass along a half-heard time?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Dane! The repair drive’s moving along—Mara’s crew is sorting tools, and I’m waiting on Sam’s report before I share firm weekend times or spots for extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Jules—that’s helpful. I’ll keep the list to Mara’s crew sorting tools for now and hold off on any weekend times or extra-hand spots until Sam’s report comes in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, Dane—thanks for keeping it careful. I’ll let you know as soon as Sam’s report comes in, and I’ll double-check with Mara before we call anything fully locked in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Pia, I’m still getting the repair drive sorted, but Leo said we should focus on locks, leaks, and no heat once Rosa’s list comes in—and Gus can bring tools for that.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds right, Noah, but let’s not dispatch anyone until Rosa’s list has addresses, callback numbers, and the exact repair issue so we can route Gus and the volunteers efficiently.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, good catch—I was about to get ahead of myself. I’ll wait for Rosa’s addresses, callback numbers, and exact issues before sending Gus or anyone else out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Leo—right now we’ve got Saturday 10 to noon as the firm repair drive window, and I’m waiting on Sam to confirm the community room tables and east entrance supplies before I place extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good. Hold extra hands until Sam confirms, and once Rosa’s list comes in we’ll assign first to locks, leaks, and no heat.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, Leo—I’ll keep Sam’s group unassigned until his location check comes in, then match them against Rosa’s list with locks, leaks, and no heat first.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Sam — Quinn’s bringing the repair drive details by and helping spread the word, so they’re probably the best one to check with. I’m keeping a little quiet right now, but I’m glad folks are helping.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Uli—I’ll check with Quinn before passing anything along, and I’ll keep it low-key on your end.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Sam. I appreciate you keeping it gentle, and I hope the repair drive helps folks who need it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Mina — I’m still checking with Quinn for the repair drive start time, so I’m not spreading anything definite yet, but I’ll let you know once it’s solid.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Tess — please get me Quinn’s confirmed start time by tonight if you can. Also tell me whether anyone on your end has tools committed, especially drills, ladders, or extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do, Mina — I’ll try to get Quinn’s confirmed time tonight, and I’ll also ask around on my block about drills, ladders, and extension cords before I pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Cleo—if I’ve got it right, the repair drive is starting around 10, with the wobbly benches and maybe the shed roof first, but I’m just about to check the list so I don’t muddle it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s right on the 10 o’clock drop-off, Oren, but Rosa’s putting safety issues first—broken locks, active leaks, and no heat—so check the list before putting benches or the shed roof up top.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Cleo—I nearly had that backwards. I’ll check Rosa’s list now and tell folks safety issues come first: locks, active leaks, and no heat.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hi Mara, I’ve told Noah I’m in for the repair drive, and Eli’s gathering a list of fixes so I can pack the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s great, Gus—thank you. We’re centering the repair drive Saturday 10 to noon while Faye can cover check-in or sorting, so Eli’s fix list will help us make good use of your tools then.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Saturday 10 to noon works for me, Mara—I’ll keep an eye out for Eli’s list and bring the tools that match, plus the workbench if it’ll help.
